integrity.proof_status: analytical argument with local polylogarithm expansion; finite executable corroboration only
integrity.source_date_note: 2004-08-17 is the earliest independently verified complete public date for the selected motivating disk-kernel article. An earlier 2002 manuscript mention lacks a verified calendar day.

scientific_limitations: Complete near-boundary nodal counts are asserted for negative Sobolev exponents excluding negative even integers; sign change holds at every negative exponent.
The theorem does not classify global zero-set connectivity or all boundary interactions.
The 2004 Lions-formula harmonic reproducing-kernel article has highly relevant disk examples, but its full text could not be inspected in this comparison; historical-priority risk remains.
title: Sobolev-sign transition and a nodal-ray staircase for harmonic Steklov kernels
